newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African gold stocks follow bullion lower.
newsitem.headline: South African gold stocks follow bullion lower.

text.p: South African gold stocks felt the brunt of a weak bullion price which on Monday sank to its lowest level in over three years.

Almost 2.5 percent was shaved off the value of the gold index, with dealers predicting further downside for the metal and shares on Tuesday. The gold index fell 2.48 percent or 36.2 points to 1,421.8 -- its lowest level in a year.
Dealers said there was, however, no heavy sell-off of gold shares. Share weakness was also capped by the rand which spent most of the day holding weaker against the U.S. dollar above the 4.70 level.

Industrial shares ended a touch firmer retracing off firmer morning levels on futures-related basket trading and held steady for the afternoon in quiet dealings. The index ended six points better at 7,882.5.
